correctness.rationale: With \(a\) additions, \(d\) deletions, and \(p\) preserving moves, petal count gives \(d-a=4\) and path length \(2a+4+p\). Published hardness gives \(a\ge1\), so every path shorter than eight has exactly one addition, five deletions, and at most one preserving move. The exact checker exhausts a stronger relaxation allowing arbitrary \(\mathsf R,\mathsf S\) at zero cost and at most one \(\mathsf X\), finds no terminal path, and separately verifies both eight-move upper paths. The proof therefore establishes exactly the claimed two distances.
